# netactuate_oidc_clients (Data Source)

Reads OIDC Clients visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_oidc_clients" "example" {
}
```

- `clients` (List of Object) OIDC clients visible to the account (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clients))
